title: Low-poly character (UltraTex pipeline)
description: A full-body character at about 12,000 triangles, in an A-pose, ready for auto-rigging. Hold weapons and items as separate props. Slower (about 4-5 min) and its texture weights are reported non-commercial; the default on cards under 12 GB.

fast.description: Quickest usable character: 4,000 triangles, coarser grids, fewer sampling steps.

max.description: Highest quality in one piece: full shape resolution and texture sampling at 25 steps.
